label: Foucault rejected the Marcusean 'repressive hypothesis' in The History of Sexuality, arguing power produces and incites discourse rather than simply repressing desire
description: Michel Foucault formulated a fundamental critique of "One-Dimensional Man & Repressive Desublimation", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
